k:multilingual-eval-faq@1.1:e2ea02bf.excerpt:
## Tool issues

### Q: Characters or tone marks appear as boxes or become unreadable in LT.
Report a tool-rendering incident and check the text outside LT where possible. Until that comparison is available, do not claim the underlying response itself has corrupted characters.

k:multilingual-eval-faq@1.1:9ea83675.excerpt:
## Regional variation

### Q: Are Vietnamese regional words always penalized?
No. Confirm the intended locale or audience. Vocabulary natural for that audience is acceptable even when another reviewer would use a different regional term. If the required locale is unclear, obtain that context before deciding.

k:multi-locale-announcement@1.0:e97783e3.excerpt:

Multilingual batch 11: confirm the requested audience or locale before penalizing regional wording. Natural Southern Vietnamese vocabulary is not an error solely because a reviewer prefers a Northern term. Provide the exact phrase and prompt context. Send Korean cases to Hana, Japanese cases to Yuki, Vietnamese cases to Linh and Spanish cases to Leo. For register shifts, include the addressee and any quotation; an apparent shift is not an automatic major penalty.

k:multilingual-eval-instructions@1.2:b26.excerpt:
## Regional variation and naturalness
Assess wording against the specified locale or audience. Natural Southern Vietnamese vocabulary is not an error merely because a Northern reviewer prefers a different word. Reviewer preference or a majority vote alone does not establish a linguistic defect; identify the wording and its effect.

k:multilingual-eval-instructions@1.2:ea9.excerpt:
## Tool incidents and submission
Boxes, missing diacritics or broken characters in LT are tool-rendering incidents until the source text is checked. Compare outside the tool where possible. If unavailable, record the limitation rather than asserting that the model produced corrupt text.

Capture task IDs for rendering or submission failures. Treat tool impact under the operational incident rubric, separately from language-quality grades. A saved rating is not proof of a completed submission.
